Classical projectivity of Hermitian geometric automorphisms and faithful descent show all abstract K-automorphisms are projective. Exact local checker confirmed s=3,5,7 and enumerated all point-fixing PGL_3(F_9) transformations.

value.rationale: For the uniquely determined one-rational-point Hermitian-relative family, the exact full finite-field automorphism group is a natural central symmetry invariant. Its nonabelian Heisenberg subgroup and order for all prime powers s>=3 identify the arithmetic descent from the much larger geometric PGU group, information unavailable from rational point counts and useful for quotient and code-symmetry studies. Not an arbitrary small-parameter computation.
